headline: Johnson Controls (NYSE:JCI) Posts Better-Than-Expected Sales In Q2 CY2026, Stock Soars
summary: Building operations company Johnson Controls (NYSE:JCI) reported Q2 CY2026 results beating Wall Street’s revenue expectations, with sales up 9.3% year on year to $6.61 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.42 per share was 9% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

headline: Johnson Controls Reports Strong Q3 Results; Raises FY26 Guidance
summary: Johnson Controls International plc (NYSE: JCI), a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, is proud to announce fiscal third quarter 2026 GAAP earnings per share ("EPS") of $1.23. Adjusted EPS was $1.42.
